raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- Set the test helper's `_results_ready` event from the results queue's `put()` instead of inside `batch_lookup()` in `test_async_lookup.py`

`test_found_key_returns_true` fails intermittently with `assert None is True` (https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/95734 on `main`, and https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/95743). The helper set the event inside `batch_lookup()`, while `AsyncLookupManager`'s worker only posts the results to `_pending_results` after `batch_lookup()` returns, so a test waking in between drains an empty queue and `lookup()` still returns `None`. Holding that window open with a 1 ms delay before the post fails the original test 200/200; with this change it passes 200/200 at 1, 5 and 20 ms, every test in the file passes 20/20 with a 5 ms delay, and the file passed 10/10 runs (`v1/kv_offload`: 775 passed). This only touches the test; #57474 and #61717 change the same file but keep the event where it was.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

detail.body:
- Set the test helper's `_results_ready` event from the results queue's `put()` instead of inside `batch_lookup()` in `test_async_lookup.py`

`test_found_key_returns_true` fails intermittently with `assert None is True` (https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/95734 on `main`, and https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/95743). The helper set the event inside `batch_lookup()`, while `AsyncLookupManager`'s worker only posts the results to `_pending_results` after `batch_lookup()` returns, so a test waking in between drains an empty queue and `lookup()` still returns `None`. Holding that window open with a 1 ms delay before the post fails the original test 200/200; with this change it passes 200/200 at 1, 5 and 20 ms, every test in the file passes 20/20 with a 5 ms delay, and the file passed 10/10 runs (`v1/kv_offload`: 775 passed). This only touches the test; #57474 and #61717 change the same file but keep the event where it was.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@
 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 """Unit tests for AsyncLookupManager."""
 
+import queue
 import threading
 from collections.abc import Iterable
 
@@ -19,22 +20,32 @@ def _ctx(req_id: str = "r1") -> ReqContext:
     return ReqContext(req_id=req_id)
 
 
+class _SignalingQueue(queue.SimpleQueue):
+    """Sets ``ready`` once a posted batch is visible to drain_results()."""
+
+    ready: threading.Event
+
+    def put(self, item, block=True, timeout=None):
+        super().put(item, block, timeout)
+        self.ready.set()
+
+
 class InMemoryLookupManager(AsyncLookupManager):
     """Test subclass backed by an in-memory set."""
 
     def __init__(self, existing_keys: set[OffloadKey] | None = None):
         super().__init__(tier_type="test")
         self._existing = existing_keys or set()
         self._results_ready = threading.Event()
+        self._pending_results = _SignalingQueue()
+        self._pending_results.ready = self._results_ready
         self.batch_lookup_calls = 0
 
     def batch_lookup(
         self, keys: list[OffloadKey], req_context: ReqContext
     ) -> Iterable[bool]:
         self.batch_lookup_calls += 1
-        results = [k in self._existing for k in keys]
-        self._results_ready.set()
-        return results
+        return [k in self._existing for k in keys]
